summary: Validated build v1.6.5-webm-transcode. CRITICAL: /api/users/video/upload's webm branch returns a .mp4 URL and GCS reports content-type: video/mp4, but the stored bytes are still the ORIGINAL webm (EBML magic 1a45dfa3). iOS Safari will continue to see a black card despite the transcode wiring. Startup migration + feed + Cosmic Phoenix intro are all correct H.264/AAC mp4 — only the runtime upload path is broken.

critical.issue: Uploaded webm→mp4 URL serves webm/matroska bytes (magic 1a45dfa3, video codec vp8) with Content-Type video/mp4. The transcoded mp4 file is created on tmp but never uploaded — the inner `_upload()` closure calls `blob.upload_from_file(spool, ...)` while `spool` still holds the original webm bytes; `upload_src` (the mp4 file handle) is assigned but never used. Fix: `blob.upload_from_file(upload_src, rewind=True, ...)` (and ensure the temp mp4 handle is closed in finally). iOS Safari will still fail to decode intros recorded on Chrome/Android post-fix.
critical.reproduction: curl -X POST $BURL/api/users/video/upload -H 'Authorization: Bearer <QA>' -F 'file=@/tmp/gen.webm;type=video/webm'  →  returned URL .mp4 → curl the URL → first 4 bytes = 0x1a45dfa3 (EBML), ffprobe reports vp8+opus in matroska container.
critical.evidence: test_webm_transcode.py::test_webm_upload_returns_mp4_url_and_serves_true_mp4 FAILED with AssertionError showing bytes[4:8]=b'\x9fB\x86\x81' (expected b'ftyp').

rca_of_the_issue: SYMPTOM: iOS-only black video card for real users; supposed fix ships a webm→mp4 transcoder in POST /api/users/video/upload. VERIFICATION FAILURE: While the URL rename (.webm→.mp4) and Content-Type header (video/mp4) are applied, the file body in GCS is the untranscoded webm. ROOT CAUSE: variable-shadowing bug in /app/backend/users.py L314-355 — the transcoded output is opened into `upload_src` but the inline `_upload` closure hardcodes `spool`, so `upload_from_file` streams the original webm bytes into `<uid>.mp4`. Migration path (_run_webm_transcode_migration in server.py) is independent and correct (uses upload_from_filename on the transcoded dst), which is why the DB shows 0 .webm URLs and existing users like Cosmic Phoenix play fine — that masked the runtime upload regression during self-verification. MITIGATION: 1-line change: `blob.upload_from_file(upload_src, rewind=True, ...)`; also close `upload_src` in finally.
